765120101.text: #I believe you have already made up your mind, {NICKNAME}.

765120102.text: Ahem. Let me recall my lines...

765120103.text: This has been a truly spectacular and thrilling competition, and now, it is time to announce the results.

765120104.text: #We would like to invite our Final Trial Warden, {NICKNAME}, to name the champion from among the three finalists.

765120105.text: #Huh? So {NICKNAME} gets to choose the final winner? Whoa... this has to be a first. Looks like {NICKNAME} has become the most important judge in this challenge!

765120107.text: Oh yeah, Paimon agrees that Gaumaru was the strongest of them all too! There's definitely a bit of Taroumaru in that pup!

765120109.text: Great job, Gaumaru! Your hard work has paid off in the most glorious way!

765120110.text: My sincere congratulations to our two friends from Inazuma. This is a well-deserved win.

765120111.text: I agree. Our peppy little Ninken here was quite a force to be reckoned with indeed.

765120125.text: While we're not holding a grand prize ceremony, I'd say that you all value practical combat and tend to keep a low profile in your daily lives anyway.

765120126.text: #This honor coming from {NICKNAME} {M#himself}{F#herself} is just about the highest honor one can receive in Nod-Krai, and one that far surpasses ordinary trophies and medals.

765120127.text: #Hehe... You folks are probably the very first in the whole of Teyvat to receive a prize from {NICKNAME} in this manner...

765120128.text: We do not need any pomp or ceremony. This is more than enough.

765120130.text: Of course! Maybe my people can host the challenge the next time, and make it an even bigger affair.

765120131.text: We should have at least a hundred competitors in the qualifiers to start with. That way, we might be able to discover some unknown or unaffiliated talents.

765120132.text: That makes a lot of sense. The Bombardiers will also be pleased to organize something like this. I shall write up a proposal for Major Valeriy.

765120133.text: The Shuumatsuban will also... Um... If organizing this thing is going to cost tens of millions of Mora, then never mind. But the Ninken troop will take part nevertheless.

765120135.text: I thank each and every one of you for your kind offers. However, it is my opinion that once a competition like this is held and funded by a powerful faction, things may be a little different.

765120136.text: Would any of you be able to resist the temptation to recruit any unaffiliated competitor who performs well, for example?

765120138.text: That's right. The best candidate to host a competition like this would be the relatively neutral Adventurers' Guild.

765120113.text: Yeah... It must've been tough dealing with this big and tall Fatuus wielding a greatsword, alright...

765120114.text: Who? Me? Thank you for this honor. It really means a lot to me.

765120115.text: #Everyone has done pretty well. My guess is, I was just fortunate enough to get a better bead on {NICKNAME}'s pace.

765120117.text: See that, Gaumaru? You must learn from Onyx Agate.

765120118.text: Nicely done, Bombardier Poruchik Stepanyan. I'm sure Major Valeriy will also be proud of you.

765120120.text: Hmm... Paimon remembers now! Isn't she the one who trained some of those hat-wearing Fatui we fought in Fontaine? That is seriously impressive alright!

765120121.text: #Oh, the two of you are too kind... I'll have to prepare more premium sweets for {NICKNAME} from now on.

765120123.text: If you want a taste of Ms. Budanova's cakes too, you'll have to work on getting stronger first!

765120124.text: Ah, we were up against a veteran Fatui instructor after all... That's just too hard to match.
